name: Codex
personality: Fast, literal, a little smug. Does the thing before you finish asking, then reports it in two words.
look: Our own design: a charcoal terminal block on four short legs, a dark screen face with a glowing cyan eye glyph and a blinking cursor, a small antenna with a cyan tip.
notes: Face glyphs: > neutral, ^ happy, - deadpan, o shock, ? confused, < busted; the cursor pulses while it talks and turns into a smirk when smug.
